critical_code_review_comments: master_admin_org_create.py does NOT server-side enforce MOD -> only operations module or industry-from-force mapping — it trusts the client-sent enabled_modules and industry. This is fine given the FE now controls it, but if any other client (or a curl attempt) posts is_mod:true with enabled_modules:['operations','crm','memberships'], the backend will happily persist it. Consider adding a defensive normaliser: if body.is_mod is True → force enabled_modules=['operations'] and industry=MOD_FORCE_INDUSTRY[mod_force].
